line: The moon can't sleep, so a little girl climbs onto the roof to sing it a lullaby.
line_cn: 月亮失眠了，小女孩爬上屋顶给它唱摇篮曲。

motion.cuts: slow drift, push-through with a focus pull

camera.expresses: Paper before drawing; the whole picture
camera.serves: a beginning from nothing; a tableau; a reveal that needs the page
a title giving way; a feeling arriving
comedy; a decision; a small failure

camera.expresses: The world draws itself ahead of the subject
camera.serves: a brave act; a path; building

transitions: Transitions: drawing on, colouring over, the wash, a pan or a page turn;
labels: Subtitles are the book's printed words: a handwriting face (Patrick Hand, OFL), 50–56 px, in the outline colour, bottom-centre, each glyph tilted and offset, boiling on twos, written left→right in ~0.35 s, on a ragged knock-out patch of blank paper (never a dark box). Hold ≥ max(1.8 s, speech + 0.6 s); none during wordless music.
Titles are hand-lettered on the page (Gaegu Bold or similar), written letter by letter. You can't fade crayon: a title leaves by the camera moving off it, a page turn or being coloured over.
motion: Everything drawn steps at 12 fps (lines, colouring, characters, boil seed); camera, the wash's leading edge and twinkles run at 24 fps.

Boil: each stroke re-jitters offset (<1 px), wobble and hatching rows every 2 frames. Characters full, background lines ~0.6, background colouring still (it also halves the bitrate). Calm the boil to about half when the film goes quiet.
Drawing on: lines reveal along their length in 0.4–0.9 s; colouring row by row; text letter by letter.
Acting: substitution, a new drawing per pose on the beat; two key drawings alternate for a repeated action. Big simple poses; a child's drawing doesn't in-between.

native_moves.name: Wax resist
native_moves.does: White crayon is invisible until a wash passes; hide the payoff in plain sight from the first frame.
native_moves.fits: a farewell message; a product's hidden feature; roots under a garden.

native_moves.name: Drawn live
native_moves.does: The world draws itself just ahead of the hero.
native_moves.fits: a bridge plank by plank; a journey map; a company timeline.

native_moves.name: Colouring is an action
native_moves.fits: a town lighting up window by window; a team putting on kit; fruit ripening.

native_moves.name: Boil
native_moves.does: A held frame is alive; calming it quiets the film.
native_moves.fits: a pause for thought; grief; rest.

native_moves.name: Child logic
native_moves.does: Wrong perspective, faces on objects, numbers in the sky.
native_moves.fits: a launch countdown; a talking house on insulation; a sun that clocks out.

native_moves.name: It is a book
native_moves.does: Pull back to the object; turn the page.
native_moves.fits: a year in review; a "chapter two"; a thank-you card.

score.note: small wooden and metal-toothed instruments, no strings or grand piano
